BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   D. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

4. Which statement about Procurement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Procurement.
   B. Say Procurement never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Procurement as rumours only.
   D. Explain Procurement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

6. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   B. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   D. Treat Marketing as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Methods of Price Determination is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Methods of Price Determination never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Methods of Price Determination with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Methods of Price Determination.
   D. Treat Methods of Price Determination as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.

10. Which statement about Trial Balance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Trial Balance as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Trial Balance.
   C. Say Trial Balance never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Trial Balance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about The Ledger is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat The Ledger as rumours only.
   B. Say The Ledger never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing The Ledger.
   D. Explain The Ledger with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Savings and Investments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Savings and Investments never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Savings and Investments.
   C. Explain Savings and Investments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Savings and Investments as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain International Trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Business Ownership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Methods of Price Determination and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
